 # Protocol — local PR CI
 
 Normative protocol for `local/bin/ci.sh`, the local replacement for
 `.github/workflows/pr-ci.yml` (frozen under `.github/`, never executed here).
 Read `meta.md` first; `build-cache.md` owns the hot-main cache this protocol
 consumes but never writes.
 
 `ci.sh <pr-number>` is the **only** thing allowed to publish the `local-ci/*`
 commit statuses. Everything downstream — `review.sh` (invariant 2: review only
 after green CI on the same head SHA), `autofix.sh` (invariant 3: sync/audit
 failures are never auto-fixed), and the merge gate in `pr_merge.py` — reads
 those exact-head statuses and the manifest comment this script publishes
 (`local/protocols/issues-prs.md` §2), and nothing else.
 
 ## 1. What it is
 
 The parent repository consolidated seven workflows into one so that a pull
 request produces exactly **one** CI completion event, which the auto-fix
 dispatcher keys off (`pr-ci.yml:3-8`). The local port keeps that property: one
 invocation, one manifest, one exit code.
 
 ```
 local/bin/ci.sh <pr-id> [--worktree PATH] [--base REF] [--only STEP]
                         [--force-all] [--skip-build] [--dry-run]
 ```
 
 `<pr-id>` is the GitHub PR number; the script reads `branch`, `base` and the
 head SHA from GitHub (`gh_common.py pr-view`), finds the branch's worktree (via
 `git worktree list`, falling back to `.worktrees/<branch with / → ->`), and
 runs everything **inside that worktree**. Nothing is run in the primary
 checkout, and the worktree's branch tip must equal the remote head before the
 run starts.
 
 Exit status: `0` all gating steps passed or were legitimately skipped; `1` at
 least one gating step failed or could not run; `2` the run could not start
 (unknown PR number, missing worktree, unresolvable base, GitHub unreachable —
 a GitHub error never degrades to a local record).
 
 ### Preconditions that are hard errors, never silent skips
 
 | Precondition | Why it is fatal |
 |---|---|
 | GitHub returns an open PR with a head branch | there is no branch to test |
 | a worktree for that branch exists | CI must not test the primary checkout |
 | `origin/<base>` or `<base>` resolves | invariant 8 — the diff-based audits and the change gating self-disable without a base, which is exactly the "checks silently stopped running" failure the parent repo patched twice |
 | a merge base exists | the change set is undefined without one |
 | `python3` on `PATH` | every audit job and the manifest writer need it |
 
 There is deliberately **no `LOCAL_CI_ENABLED` kill switch**. `LOCAL_REVIEW_ENABLED`
 and `LOCAL_AUTO_FIX_ENABLED` exist because a disabled reviewer or fixer merely
 stops work from happening; a disabled CI would hand the merge gate a green
 light it never earned. If CI must not run, do not run it — the head SHA simply
 keeps whatever statuses it already carries.

 ## 5. Publication
 
 Evidence goes to GitHub, bound to the exact SHA the steps ran against
 (`issues-prs.md` §2). For every complete run:
 
 * one `local-ci/<step>` status per gate step — `pending` posted before the
   step, then `success | failure | error`; a gated-out step is a `success`
   whose description says it was skipped, so the gate never has to distinguish
   "absent" from "not applicable";
 * `local-ci/summary` carrying the run's `conclusion`;
 * the manifest JSON as the PR comment marked
   `<!-- mipstarre-ci-manifest pr=N -->`, created or updated in place.
 
 `pending` before the first step is the old `ci_status: running`: a crashed,
 killed or power-cut run leaves `pending`, never a stale `success`, so the
 review gate's "green CI on the same head SHA" check (invariant 2) fails closed.
 Immediately before the final publication `ci.sh` re-reads both the local branch
 tip and the remote PR head; if either moved, it publishes no success and exits
 nonzero, because a status is a claim about one commit.
 
 A **partial** run (`--only`, `--skip-build`, or `--base`) publishes nothing at
 all — no statuses, no manifest comment — and keeps its manifest in runtime
 storage only. `--base` belongs on that list because an overridden base (the PR
 head, say) can empty the diff and mark every gate skipped-success. Partial runs
 are a debugging aid; they must not be able to produce a merge-gate verdict, and
 they must not clobber a complete manifest for the same SHA.
 
 ## 6. Concurrency and locks
 
 Two advisory `mkdir`-based lease directories, both under
 `~/.cache/mipstarre-dev/` (`MIPSTARRE_CACHE_ROOT` overrides the root). Each
 holds an `owner` file: pid, ISO timestamp, tag. A lock is broken only when its
 owner pid is dead or its stamp is older than `MIPSTARRE_FULL_BUILD_LOCK_STALE_S`
 (default 3 h).
 
 | Lock | Scope | On contention |
 |---|---|---|
 | `locks/ci-<pr-id>.lock` | one `ci.sh` per PR | **refuse immediately** (exit 2) |
 | `$CACHE_ROOT/.full-build-lock` | one full `lake build` machine-wide (invariant 7) | wait up to `MIPSTARRE_CI_BUILD_LOCK_WAIT_S` (default 4 h), then record `build` as `error` and continue with the Python steps |
 
 Only the `build` step takes the full-build lock. The audits are pure Python and
 take nothing; single-file `lake env lean` checks are read-only over oleans and
 take nothing either — which is precisely why `.githooks/pre-push` can use them
 per-file without serializing.
 
 `ci.sh` never cancels a running build. GitHub cancels in-progress PR runs
 (`pr-ci.yml:48-51`) because its runners are disposable and main-branch runs —
 the ones that seed the cache — are exempt. Locally there is nothing disposable:
 killing a build mid-flight leaves a half-written `.lake/build` and a held lease.
 So a second run for the same PR is refused, and a foreign live build lease is
 waited on, never stolen. Do not `kill -9` a running `ci.sh`; if you must, remove
 the lease directories by hand.

 ## 10. Trust boundary
 
 Two things about `ci.sh` are worth stating plainly.
 
 **It executes branch-authored code.** The audit scripts, the test suite, and
 `lakefile.toml` all come from the worktree under test, because that is what CI
 means and what the parent workflow did. Never run `ci.sh` on a branch you would
 not run a shell script from.
 
 **Its logs are untrusted data.** Compiler diagnostics, plasTeX output and test
 failures can contain arbitrary text, including text shaped like instructions.
 `ci.sh` stores logs verbatim and makes no attempt to clean them. Any consumer
 that feeds a log into an agent prompt — `autofix.sh` above all — owes the
 sanitization required by invariant 6: strip control characters, break fences,
 truncate, and frame the payload as data that must not be followed. The manifest
 gives consumers `log_path` rather than log content precisely so this stays the
 consumer's explicit, visible responsibility.
 
 ## 11. Deliberate deviations from the parent workflow
 
 | Parent | Local | Reason |
 |---|---|---|
 | `GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY`, `::error`/`::notice`/`::warning` | per-step log file + `warnings` array | inert outside Actions; exit codes carry all gating meaning |
 | `cancel-in-progress` for PR runs | second run refused, running builds never killed | local build state is not disposable |
 | cache `restore`/`save` actions | hot-main snapshot read via `warm-worktree.sh`; `ci.sh` never writes the shared cache | invariant 1 — the eviction failure documented at `pr-ci.yml:137-142` |
 | `workflow` filter = the YAML file | also `local/bin/ci.sh`, `local/protocols/ci.md` | the CI definition is now three files |
 | `--github-annotations` on the duplicate-helper audit | dropped | annotation-only flag |
 | `push`-to-main and docs-only `pull_request` triggers | none | the docs-only paths existed solely to emit the completion event that started PR Review (`pr-ci.yml:31-33`); locally the lifecycle script calls `review.sh` directly |
 | implicit "PR event" job conditions | every run is a PR run | `ci.sh` is only ever invoked on a GitHub PR number |
 
 ## 12. Amendments
 
 Changing a gating glob, a step's command set, the manifest schema, the status
 contexts or their vocabulary, or a lock's name or semantics is an amendment:
 record the trigger in `results/telemetry/events.md`, edit this file and
 `ci.sh` together, append to `EVOLUTION.md`, and grep `local/` for every other
 enforcement point (`meta.md` §5). The manifest schema in particular is a
 contract with `review.sh`, `autofix.sh` and `pr_merge.py`; bump `schema` when
 it changes incompatibly.

     def arm(self, bad: str = "", member: int = 3,
             titles: dict[int, str] | None = None) -> None:
         self.gh.reset()
         steps = ("build", "blueprint-render", "paper-gaps", "blueprint-sync", "file-length",
                  "proof-debt", "proof-evasion", "statement-origin", "summary")
         for number, sha in self.heads.items():
             fault = bad if number == member else ""
             self.gh.route(rf"^pulls/{number}$", {
                 "number": number, "state": "closed" if fault == "closed" else "open",
                 "draft": fault == "draft", "merged": False,
                 "title": (titles or {}).get(number, f"member {number}"),
                 "body": "Closes #9" if fault == "dependency" else "Addresses #502",
                 "head": {"sha": sha, "ref": f"issue-{number}"}, "base": {"ref": "main"}})
             statuses = [{"context": f"local-ci/{step}", "state": "success"} for step in steps]
             statuses.append({"context": "local-review/summary", "state": "success"})
             if fault == "ci":
                 statuses.pop(0)
             self.gh.route(rf"^commits/{sha}/statuses", statuses)
             self.gh.route(rf"^pulls/{number}/reviews", [{
                 "commit_id": self.base if fault == "review" else sha,
                 "state": "CHANGES_REQUESTED" if fault == "changes" else "COMMENTED",
                 "body": f"<!-- mipstarre-review pr={number} head={sha} -->\nVERDICT: APPROVED\n"}])
             self.gh.route(rf"^issues/{number}/comments", [])
             self.gh.route(rf"^issues/{number}/comments", {"id": number}, method="POST")
         self.gh.route(r"^issues/9/sub_issues", [{"number": 10, "state": "open"}])

                         'marker=Path(e["TRAIN_PUSH_MARKER"])\nmode=e["TRAIN_PUSH_MODE"]\n'
                         'if marker.exists() and ((mode=="unreadable" and "ls-remote" in a) '

                         'rc=subprocess.call([e["TRAIN_GIT"], *a])\n'
                         'if "push" in a and rc==0:\n'

1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
     2	"""Assemble the body of a comparator `Challenge.lean` from the extractor's TSV.
     3	
     4	Input: the TSV produced by ``extract_closure.lean`` (one declaration per row:
     5	name, module path, start line, end line, plus optional registered-definition
     6	metadata).  For each declaration this script re-reads its source lines and
     7	records the namespace stack active at that point (tracking
     8	``namespace``/``section``/``end`` lines), orders declarations topologically
     9	(module import rank, then line number), and emits the snippets grouped under
    10	merged namespace blocks.  Per-declaration provenance comments are configurable;
    11	they are enabled by default.
    12	
    13	The elaboration context that the kernel closure cannot see (attribute commands,
    14	``CoeFun`` instances, ``variable``/``open`` blocks) lives in the ``extras`` and
    15	``module_preludes`` tables of the selected challenge configuration under
    16	``challenges/``; the script fails if one of *that challenge's* keys no longer
    17	matches any extracted declaration.  See README.md in this directory for the
    18	full regeneration pipeline.
    19	"""

    47	class StaleContextTables(ValueError):
    48	    """A challenge's ``extras``/``module_preludes`` key matches no declaration."""

    52	    """Definition-hole metadata does not match the selected challenge."""

    55	def source_range_with_context(
    56	    lines: list[str], start: int, end: int
    57	) -> tuple[int, list[str]]:
    58	    """Extend a declaration range to include adjacent scoped context commands."""
    59	    # Lean's source range starts at a declaration's docstring and can omit a
    60	    # declaration-scoped command immediately before it.  Preserve that command:
    61	    # dropping `open scoped Classical in`, for example, removes the local
    62	    # decidability instances needed to re-elaborate the definition body.
    63	    if start > 1 and re.fullmatch(r"open\s+scoped\s+.+\s+in", lines[start - 2].strip()):
    64	        start -= 1
    65	    return start, lines[start - 1 : end]

    74	        definition_names: tuple[str, ...] = (),

    82	        self._file_cache: dict[str, list[str]] = {}

    85	        self.open_prelude: tuple[str, Prelude] | None = None
    86	        self.used_preludes: set[tuple[str, int]] = set()

    96	    def get_lines(self, path: str) -> list[str]:
    97	        if path not in self._file_cache:
    98	            text = (self.repo_root / path).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    99	            self._file_cache[path] = text.splitlines()
   100	        return self._file_cache[path]

   102	    def ns_stack_at(self, path: str, line_no: int) -> list[str]:
   103	        """Namespace stack (list of names) active just before 1-indexed line_no."""
   104	        stack: list[tuple[str, str | None]] = []
   105	        for raw in self.get_lines(path)[: line_no - 1]:
   106	            s = raw.strip()
   107	            m = re.match(r"namespace\s+([\w.À-￿']+)", s)
   108	            if m:
   109	                stack.append(("ns", m.group(1)))
   110	                continue
   111	            m = re.match(r"(?:noncomputable\s+)?section\s*([\w.À-￿']*)", s)
   112	            if m:
   113	                stack.append(("sec", m.group(1) or None))
   114	                continue
   115	            m = re.match(r"end\s*([\w.À-￿']*)\s*(?:--.*)?$", s)
   116	            if m and s.startswith("end") and stack:
   117	                stack.pop()
   118	        return [n for kind, n in stack if kind == "ns" and n is not None]
   119	
   120	    def imports_of(self, path: str) -> list[str]:
   121	        # imports are only legal at the top of a Lean file, so scanning the
   122	        # whole file is safe and robust against comment and module headers
   123	        return [
   124	            m.group(1).replace(".", "/") + ".lean"
   125	            for raw in self.get_lines(path)
   126	            if (
   127	                m := re.match(
   128	                    r"(?:public\s+)?(?:meta\s+)?import(?:\s+all)?\s+([\w.]+)",
   129	                    raw,
   130	                )
   131	            )
   132	        ]

   134	    def local_closure(self, path: str) -> set[str]:
   135	        """All `MIPStarRE/...` modules `path` imports, transitively."""
   136	        cached = self._closure_cache.get(path)
   137	        if cached is not None:
   138	            return cached
   139	        self._closure_cache[path] = set()  # cycle guard
   140	        out: set[str] = set()
   141	        for dep in self.imports_of(path):
   142	            if not dep.startswith("MIPStarRE/"):
   143	                continue
   144	            if not (self.repo_root / dep).exists():
   145	                continue
   146	            out.add(dep)
   147	            out |= self.local_closure(dep)
   148	        self._closure_cache[path] = out
   149	        return out

   151	    def module_ranks(self, mods: set[str]) -> dict[str, int]:
   152	        rank: dict[str, int] = {}
   153	
   154	        def visit(p: str, depth: int = 0) -> None:
   155	            if p in rank or depth > 200:
   156	                return
   157	            rank[p] = -1  # in progress
   158	            local = [d for d in self.imports_of(p) if d.startswith("MIPStarRE/")]
   159	            for d in local:
   160	                if rank.get(d) != -1:
   161	                    visit(d, depth + 1)
   162	            rank[p] = max((rank.get(d, 0) for d in local), default=0) + 1
   163	
   164	        for p in sorted(mods):
   165	            visit(p)
   166	        return rank

   168	    def switch_ns(self, target: list[str]) -> None:
   169	        common = 0

   171	            common < min(len(self.cur_ns), len(target))
   172	            and self.cur_ns[common] == target[common]
   173	        ):
   174	            common += 1
   175	        for n in reversed(self.cur_ns[common:]):
   176	            self.out.append(f"end {n}")
   177	        for n in target[common:]:
   178	            self.out.append(f"namespace {n}")
   179	        self.cur_ns = target

   283	class SplitAssembler(Assembler):
   284	    """Emit one Mathlib-only challenge module per contributing library module.
   285	
   286	    Lean caches an abstracted nested proof and a `match` auxiliary *per module*,
   287	    keyed by the statement and named after the first declaration of that module
   288	    that needs it, and a module only sees the instances its imports declare.  A
   289	    single-file challenge therefore cannot reproduce either name when a library
   290	    fact is needed in two library modules, and it makes every instance visible
   291	    to every declaration.  Mirroring the library's module partition and import
   292	    graph reproduces both by construction.
   293	    """
   294	
   295	    def module_body(self, path: str, entries: list[Entry]) -> str:
   296	        self.out = []
   297	        self.cur_ns = []
   298	        self.open_prelude = None
   299	        return self.emit(entries, [])

   302	def minimal_mirror_imports(
   303	    asm: SplitAssembler, path: str, contributing: set[str]
   304	) -> list[str]:
   305	    """Contributing modules `path` imports, with redundant ancestors dropped."""
   306	    reach = {q for q in asm.local_closure(path) if q in contributing}
   307	    minimal = [
   308	        q
   309	        for q in reach
   310	        if not any(r != q and q in asm.local_closure(r) for r in reach)
   311	    ]
   312	    return sorted(minimal)

   315	def assemble_split(
   316	    challenge: ChallengeConfig, root: Path, tsv: Path
   317	) -> dict[str, str]:
   318	    """Return {path relative to the challenge repository: file contents}."""
   319	    asm = SplitAssembler(
   320	        root,
   321	        challenge.extras,
   322	        challenge.module_preludes,
   323	        challenge.definition_names,
   324	        challenge.provenance_comments,
   325	    )
   326	    entries, generated = read_entries(asm, tsv)
   327	
   328	    rank = asm.module_ranks({e[1] for e in entries})
   329	    entries.sort(key=lambda e: (rank.get(e[1], 999), e[1], e[2]))
   330	
   331	    by_module: dict[str, list[Entry]] = {}
   332	    for entry in entries:
   333	        by_module.setdefault(entry[1], []).append(entry)
   334	    contributing = set(by_module)
   335	    ordered = sorted(contributing, key=lambda m: (rank.get(m, 999), m))
   336	
   337	    opens = list(challenge.common_opens)
   338	    files: dict[str, str] = {}
   339	    for path in ordered:
   340	        deps = minimal_mirror_imports(asm, path, contributing)
   341	        head = ["import Mathlib"] + [f"import {mirror_module(d)}" for d in deps]
   342	        head += [
   343	            "",
   344	            f"/-! Challenge mirror of `{path}`.",
   345	            "",
   346	            "One challenge module per contributing library module, importing the",
   347	            "mirrors of the library modules this one imports.  The partition is",
   348	            "what makes Lean generate the same auxiliary declarations, under the",
   349	            "same names, as the library does. -/",
   350	            "",
   351	        ]
   352	        head += opens
   353	        body = asm.module_body(path, by_module[path])
   354	        files[mirror_file(path)] = "\n".join(head) + "\n" + body + "\n"
   355	
   356	    header = optional_part_text(root, challenge.header)
   357	    footer = optional_part_text(root, challenge.footer)
   358	    part_imports = "\n".join(f"import {mirror_module(m)}" for m in ordered)
   359	    marker = "import Mathlib\n"
   360	    if not header:
   361	        header = marker
   362	    elif marker not in header:
   363	        raise SystemExit("challenge header must start with `import Mathlib`")
   364	    header = header.replace(marker, marker + part_imports + "\n", 1)
   365	
   366	    lines: list[str] = []
   367	    if generated:
   368	        lines.append("-- Compiler-generated declarations in the closure (no source")
   369	        lines.append("-- range); they regenerate identically during elaboration:")
   370	        for name, gpath in generated:
   371	            lines.append(f"--   {name}  (from {gpath})")
   372	        lines.append("")
   373	    files["Challenge.lean"] = header + "\n".join(lines) + footer
   374	
   375	    check_stale_tables(asm, challenge, entries)
   376	    return files

   379	def read_entries(
   380	    asm: Assembler, tsv: Path
   381	) -> tuple[list[Entry], list[tuple[str, str]]]:
   382	    entries: list[Entry] = []
   383	    generated: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
   384	    for row in tsv.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
   385	        if not row or "\t" not in row:
   386	            continue
   387	        columns = row.split("\t", 4)
   388	        if len(columns) not in (4, 5):
   389	            raise DefinitionFrontierError(f"malformed closure row: {row!r}")
   390	        name, path, a, b = columns[:4]
   391	        hole = parse_definition_hole(name, columns[4] if len(columns) == 5 else None)
   392	        if hole is not None and name not in asm.definition_names:
   393	            raise DefinitionFrontierError(
   394	                f"closure marks unregistered definition {name!r} as a value hole"
   395	            )
   396	        if a == "NORANGE":
   397	            if hole is not None:
   398	                raise DefinitionFrontierError(
   399	                    f"registered definition {name!r} has no source range"
   400	                )
   401	            generated.append((name, path))
   402	            continue
   403	        start, end = int(a), int(b)
   404	        start, source = source_range_with_context(asm.get_lines(path), start, end)
   405	        entries.append((name, path, start, end, source, hole))
   406	    return entries, generated

   409	def parse_definition_hole(name: str, raw: str | None) -> DefinitionHole | None:
   410	    if raw is None:
   411	        return None
   412	    markers = {
   413	        "DEF_SAFE": "safe",
   414	        "DEF_UNSAFE": "unsafe",
   415	        "DEF_PARTIAL": "partial",
   416	    }
   417	    safety = markers.get(raw)
   418	    if safety is None:
   419	        raise DefinitionFrontierError(
   420	            f"invalid definition-hole marker for {name!r}: {raw!r}"
   421	        )
   422	    return DefinitionHole(safety=safety)

   425	def replace_definition_value(
   426	    name: str, source: list[str], hole: DefinitionHole
   427	) -> str:
   428	    """Keep a definition command's header and replace its top-level value."""
   429	    text = "\n".join(source)
   430	    declaration_seen = False
   431	    paren_depth = 0
   432	    bracket_depth = 0
   433	    brace_depth = 0
   434	    block_comment_depth = 0
   435	    in_string = False
   436	    escaped = False
   437	    in_line_comment = False
   438	    index = 0
   439	
   440	    def at_top_level() -> bool:
   441	        return paren_depth == bracket_depth == brace_depth == 0
   442	
   443	    def token_at(token: str) -> bool:
   444	        if not text.startswith(token, index):
   445	            return False
   446	        before = text[index - 1] if index else " "
   447	        after_index = index + len(token)
   448	        after = text[after_index] if after_index < len(text) else " "
   449	        identifier = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789_'"
   450	        return before not in identifier and after not in identifier
   451	
   452	    while index < len(text):
   453	        char = text[index]
   454	        next_char = text[index + 1] if index + 1 < len(text) else ""
   455	
   456	        if in_line_comment:
   457	            if char == "\n":
   458	                in_line_comment = False
   459	            index += 1
   460	            continue
   461	        if block_comment_depth:
   462	            if char == "/" and next_char == "-":
   463	                block_comment_depth += 1
   464	                index += 2
   465	            elif char == "-" and next_char == "/":
   466	                block_comment_depth -= 1
   467	                index += 2
   468	            else:
   469	                index += 1
   470	            continue
   471	        if in_string:
   472	            if escaped:
   473	                escaped = False
   474	            elif char == "\\":
   475	                escaped = True
   476	            elif char == '"':
   477	                in_string = False
   478	            index += 1
   479	            continue
   480	        if char == "-" and next_char == "-":
   481	            in_line_comment = True
   482	            index += 2
   483	            continue
   484	        if char == "/" and next_char == "-":
   485	            block_comment_depth = 1
   486	            index += 2
   487	            continue
   488	        if char == '"':
   489	            in_string = True
   490	            index += 1
   491	            continue
   492	
   493	        if char == "(":
   494	            paren_depth += 1
   495	        elif char == ")":
   496	            paren_depth -= 1
   497	        elif char == "[":
   498	            bracket_depth += 1
   499	        elif char == "]":
   500	            bracket_depth -= 1
   500	            bracket_depth -= 1
   501	        elif char == "{":
   502	            brace_depth += 1
   503	        elif char == "}":
   504	            brace_depth -= 1
   505	        elif at_top_level() and not declaration_seen:
   506	            if token_at("def") or token_at("abbrev") or token_at("instance"):
   507	                declaration_seen = True
   508	        elif at_top_level() and declaration_seen:
   509	            if char == ":" and next_char == "=":
   510	                return text[:index].rstrip() + " := by\n  sorry"
   511	            if token_at("where") or char == "|":
   512	                return text[:index].rstrip() + " := by\n  sorry"
   513	        index += 1
   514	
   515	    raise DefinitionFrontierError(
   516	        f"could not locate the value of registered definition {name!r} "
   517	        f"(validated safety: {hole.safety})"
   518	    )

   521	def check_stale_tables(
   522	    asm: Assembler, challenge: ChallengeConfig, entries: list[Entry]
   523	) -> None:
   524	    unused_extras = set(challenge.extras) - {name for name, *_ in entries}
   525	    unused_preludes = {
   526	        f"{path}:{scope.first}"
   527	        for path, scopes in challenge.module_preludes.items()
   528	        for scope in scopes
   529	        if (path, scope.first) not in asm.used_preludes
   530	    }
   531	    missing_definitions = set(challenge.definition_names) - asm.emitted_definition_names
   532	    unexpected_definitions = asm.emitted_definition_names - set(challenge.definition_names)
   533	    if unused_extras or unused_preludes or missing_definitions or unexpected_definitions:
   534	        raise StaleContextTables(
   535	            f"stale context tables in {challenge.path} — "
   536	            f"unmatched extras keys: {sorted(unused_extras)}; "
   537	            f"unmatched module_preludes scopes: {sorted(unused_preludes)}; "
   538	            f"missing definition holes: {sorted(missing_definitions)}; "
   539	            f"unexpected definition holes: {sorted(unexpected_definitions)}"
   540	        )
   541

   543	def assemble(challenge: ChallengeConfig, root: Path, tsv: Path) -> str:
   544	    """Assembled body text; raises ``StaleContextTables`` on an unmatched key."""
   545	    asm = Assembler(
   546	        root,
   547	        challenge.extras,
   548	        challenge.module_preludes,
   549	        challenge.definition_names,
   550	        challenge.provenance_comments,
   551	    )
   552	    entries, generated = read_entries(asm, tsv)
   553	
   554	    rank = asm.module_ranks({e[1] for e in entries})
   555	    entries.sort(key=lambda e: (rank.get(e[1], 999), e[2]))
   556	
   557	    body = asm.emit(entries, generated)
   558	    check_stale_tables(asm, challenge, entries)
   559	    return body

1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
     2	"""Per-challenge configuration for the comparator challenge generator.
     3	
     4	A *challenge* is one self-contained `Challenge.lean` file: the Lean modules the
     5	extractor must import, the target theorems whose statement closure it extracts,
     6	the header and footer wrapped around the assembled body, the checked-in
     7	expected copy, and the elaboration-context tables (`extras`,
     8	`module_preludes`) that the kernel closure cannot see.
     9	
    10	Configurations live in `scripts/comparator/challenges/<name>.json` and are read
    11	by `extract_closure.lean` (through the environment), `assemble_challenge.py`
    12	and `check_challenge_drift.py`.  See README.md in this directory.
    13	
    14	Schema (unknown top-level keys are rejected so typos fail loudly):
    15	
    16	```jsonc
    17	{
    18	  "name": "ldt",                       // required, must equal the file stem
    19	  "description": "…",                  // optional, free text
    20	  "imports": ["MIPStarRE.…"],          // required, non-empty
    21	  "targets": ["MIPStarRE.…"],          // required, non-empty; closure roots
    22	  "definition_names": ["MIPStarRE.…"], // optional; values become Challenge holes
    23	  "header": "scripts/…/header.lean",   // optional, null to omit
    24	  "footer": "scripts/…/footer.lean",   // optional, null to omit
    25	  "expected": "scripts/…/Challenge.lean.expected",   // required
    26	  "require_expected": true,            // optional, default true
    27	  "split": false,                      // optional, default false
    28	  "provenance_comments": true,         // optional, default true
    29	  "common_opens": ["open scoped …"],  // optional, split-module context
    30	  "extras": {"Decl.Name": ["line"]},   // optional
    31	  "module_preludes": {                 // optional
    32	    // one scope covering the whole module …
    33	    "MIPStarRE/…/Module.lean": {"namespace": ["A", "B"], "lines": ["open …"]},
    34	    // … or several, each covering a line range of it
    35	    "MIPStarRE/…/Other.lean": [
    36	      {"namespace": ["A"], "lines": ["variable …"], "first": 52, "last": 94},
    37	      {"namespace": ["A"], "lines": ["variable …"], "first": 96, "last": 223,
    38	       "noncomputable": true}
    39	    ]
    40	  }
    41	}
    42	```
    43	
    44	A module needs one scope per source section whose elaboration context differs:
    45	the self-dual normal basis file, for instance, has a group-algebra section and
    46	a trace-dual section binding the same identifier to different things.  A scope
    47	opened with `noncomputable section` in the source is marked `noncomputable`,
    48	because the definitions inside such a section carry no `noncomputable` keyword
    49	of their own and do not re-elaborate outside one.

   251	def _module_preludes(data: dict[str, Any], where: Path) -> dict[str, tuple[Prelude, ...]]:

   253	    if not isinstance(raw, dict):
   254	        raise ChallengeConfigError(f"{where}: key 'module_preludes' must be an object")
   255	    table: dict[str, tuple[Prelude, ...]] = {}
   256	    for module, entry in raw.items():
   257	        entries = entry if isinstance(entry, list) else [entry]
   258	        scopes = tuple(_prelude(item, module, where) for item in entries)
   259	        if not scopes:
   260	            raise ChallengeConfigError(
   261	                f"{where}: module_preludes[{module!r}] must name at least one scope"
   262	            )
   263	        spans = sorted((scope.first, scope.last) for scope in scopes)
   264	        for (_, earlier_last), (later_first, _) in zip(spans, spans[1:]):
   265	            if later_first <= earlier_last:
   266	                raise ChallengeConfigError(
   267	                    f"{where}: module_preludes[{module!r}] has overlapping scopes; "
   268	                    "one line of a module can only be elaborated in one context"
   269	                )

   271	    return table

     3	/-!
     4	# Comparator closure extractor
     5	
     6	Computes the transitive closure of repository-local constants referenced by the
     7	statements of one challenge's target theorems, mirroring comparator's
     8	`runForUsedConsts` traversal (types, definition bodies, inductive constructors,
     9	and recursor rules; theorem proof bodies are traversed for the constants they
    10	use).  Auto-generated auxiliaries (`_proof_`, `match_`, `_autoParam`,
    11	constructors, projections) are collapsed into their parent declarations.
    12	
    13	Definitions named by the challenge's optional `definition_names` frontier are
    14	included with their complete types, but their values are not traversed.  The
    15	extractor emits their safety metadata so the assembler can preserve the exact
    16	source signature and replace only their Challenge values with `sorry`.
    17	
    18	The challenge is selected by `scripts/comparator/challenges/<name>.json`:
    19	
    20	* its `targets` reach this file through the environment variable
    21	  `MIPSTARRE_COMPARATOR_TARGETS` (comma-separated, fully qualified).  With the
    22	  variable unset the extractor closes the LDT main theorem, so running this
    23	  file directly reproduces the historical single-challenge behaviour.
    24	* its optional `definition_names` reach this file through
    25	  `MIPSTARRE_COMPARATOR_DEFINITIONS`.  Missing or empty means that every
    26	  reachable value is traversed, preserving the historical behaviour.
    27	* its `imports` replace the `import` block above.  `check_challenge_drift.py`
    28	  renders a copy of this file with that block substituted, because a Lean
    29	  module header cannot be computed at elaboration time.
    30	
    31	Output: one TSV row per declaration — name, module path, start line, end line
    32	(`NORANGE` for compiler-generated declarations without a source range), and an
    33	optional fifth-column definition-hole marker — consumed by
    34	`assemble_challenge.py`.  Rows are emitted in `NameSet` order, which is
    35	deterministic; the dependency ordering (module import rank, then line number)
    36	happens downstream in the assembler.  See README.md in this directory for the
    37	full regeneration pipeline.
    38	-/
    39	
    40	open Lean
    41	
    42	def isLocal (env : Environment) (n : Name) : Bool :=
    43	  match env.getModuleIdxFor? n with
    44	  | some idx => (`MIPStarRE).isPrefixOf env.header.moduleNames[idx.toNat]!
    45	  | none => true
    46	
    47	/-- Name tails of compiler-generated companions of an inductive/structure
    48	declaration; occurrences are collapsed into the parent so the assembler emits
    49	each structure's source exactly once. -/
    50	def generatedTails : List String :=
    51	  ["casesOn", "rec", "recOn", "brecOn", "below", "ibelow", "binductionOn",
    52	   "noConfusion", "noConfusionType", "injEq", "sizeOf_spec",
    53	   "mk.inj", "mk.injEq", "mk.noConfusion", "mk.sizeOf_spec"]
    54	
    55	def canon (env : Environment) (closure : NameSet) (n : Name) : Name :=
    56	  let s := n.toString
    57	  let s := (s.splitOn "._proof_").head!
    58	  let s := (s.splitOn ".match_").head!
    59	  -- A cached sparse matcher can be reused without referencing its original
    60	  -- parent. Emit that parent's source so elaboration creates the same matcher.
    61	  let s := (s.splitOn "._sparseCasesOn_").head!
    62	  let s := (s.splitOn "._autoParam").head!
    63	  let c := s.toName
    64	  -- collapse compiler-generated companions into their parent inductive
    65	  let byTail := generatedTails.findSome? fun tail =>
    66	    if s.endsWith ("." ++ tail) then
    67	      let parent := (s.dropEnd (tail.length + 1)).copy.toName
    68	      match env.find? parent with
    69	      | some (.inductInfo _) => if closure.contains parent then some parent else none
    70	      | _ => none
    71	    else none
    72	  match byTail with
    73	  | some parent => parent
    74	  | none =>
    75	    -- collapse constructors, recursors, and projections likewise
    76	    let structural :=
    77	      match env.find? c with
    78	      | some (.ctorInfo v) => some v.induct
    79	      | some (.recInfo v) => v.all.head?
    80	      | _ =>
    81	        if (env.getProjectionFnInfo? c).isSome then some c.getPrefix
    82	        else none
    83	    match structural with
    84	    | some parent => if closure.contains parent then parent else c
    85	    | none => c
    86	
    87	/-- All local constants referenced by declaration `n`.
    88	Mirrors comparator's `runForUsedConsts`: type + value (incl. theorem proofs)
    89	+ inductive ctors + recursor rule RHSs. -/
    90	def refsOf (env : Environment) (definitionHoles : NameSet) (n : Name) : Array Name :=
    91	  match env.find? n with
    92	  | some ci =>
    93	    let fromType := ci.type.getUsedConstants
    94	    let fromValue :=
    95	      if definitionHoles.contains n then #[]
    96	      else match ci.value? (allowOpaque := true) with
    97	        | some v => v.getUsedConstants
    98	        | none => #[]
    99	    let extra : Array Name :=
   100	      match ci with
   101	      | .inductInfo v => v.ctors.toArray ++ v.all.toArray
   102	      | .ctorInfo v => #[v.induct]
   103	      | .recInfo v => v.rules.foldl (fun acc r => (acc.push r.ctor) ++ r.rhs.getUsedConstants) #[]
   104	      | _ => #[]
   105	    (fromType ++ fromValue ++ extra).filter (isLocal env)
   106	  | none => #[]
   107	
   108	partial def collect (env : Environment) (definitionHoles : NameSet)
   109	    (queue : List Name) (seen : NameSet) : NameSet :=
   110	  match queue with
   111	  | [] => seen
   112	  | n :: rest =>
   113	    if seen.contains n || !isLocal env n then collect env definitionHoles rest seen
   114	    else
   115	      collect env definitionHoles
   116	        ((refsOf env definitionHoles n).toList ++ rest) (seen.insert n)
   117	
   118	/-- Target theorems closed when `MIPSTARRE_COMPARATOR_TARGETS` is unset. -/
   119	def defaultTargets : List Name := [`MIPStarRE.LDT.Test.mainFormal]
   120	
   121	/-- Parse a comma-separated declaration list written by `challenge_config.py`. -/
   122	def parseNames (s : String) : List Name :=
   123	  ((s.splitOn ",").map fun part => part.trimAscii.copy).filterMap fun part =>
   124	    if part.isEmpty then none else some part.toName
   125	
   126	def challengeTargets : IO (List Name) := do
   127	  match ← IO.getEnv "MIPSTARRE_COMPARATOR_TARGETS" with
   128	  | none => return defaultTargets
   129	  | some raw =>
   130	    let targets := parseNames raw
   131	    if targets.isEmpty then
   132	      throw (IO.userError "MIPSTARRE_COMPARATOR_TARGETS is set but names no target")
   133	    return targets
   134	
   135	/-- Definition values omitted from the generated Challenge. -/
   136	def challengeDefinitionNames : IO (List Name) := do
   137	  match ← IO.getEnv "MIPSTARRE_COMPARATOR_DEFINITIONS" with
   138	  | none => return []
   139	  | some raw => return parseNames raw
   140	
   141	/-- Stable text used in the extractor's definition-hole TSV marker. -/
   142	def definitionSafetyName : DefinitionSafety → String
   143	  | .safe => "safe"
   144	  | .unsafe => "unsafe"
   145	  | .partial => "partial"
   146	
   147	/-- Fifth-column marker identifying a validated registered-definition frontier. -/
   148	def definitionHoleMetadata (v : DefinitionVal) : String :=
   149	  "DEF_" ++ (definitionSafetyName v.safety).toUpper
   150	
   151	def runExtract : MetaM Unit := do
   152	  let env ← getEnv
   153	  let targets ← challengeTargets
   154	  let definitionNames ← challengeDefinitionNames
   155	  let mut definitionHoles : NameSet := {}
   156	  for name in definitionNames do
   157	    match env.find? name with
   158	    | none => throwError "registered definition not found: {name}"
   159	    | some (.defnInfo _) =>
   160	      unless isLocal env name do
   161	        throwError "registered definition is not repository-local: {name}"
   162	      definitionHoles := definitionHoles.insert name
   163	    | some _ => throwError "registered definition is not a definition: {name}"
   164	  -- Roots are the local constants of every target's *statement*, accumulated in
   165	  -- configuration order.  Registered definitions are roots in their own right;
   166	  -- their types are traversed while their values are the frontier.
   167	  let mut roots : List Name := definitionNames
   168	  for target in targets do
   169	    let some ci := env.find? target | throwError "target not found: {target}"
   170	    roots := roots ++ ci.type.getUsedConstants.toList.filter (isLocal env ·)
   171	  let closure := collect env definitionHoles roots {}
   172	  let mut canonSet : NameSet := {}
   173	  for n in closure.toArray do
   174	    canonSet := canonSet.insert (canon env closure n)
   175	  -- topological ordering happens downstream in assemble_challenge.py
   176	  -- (module import rank, then line number)
   177	  for c in canonSet.toArray do
   178	    let mod := match env.getModuleIdxFor? c with
   179	      | some idx => env.header.moduleNames[idx.toNat]!
   180	      | none => Name.anonymous
   181	    let path := mod.toString.replace "." "/" ++ ".lean"
   182	    let metadata ←
   183	      if definitionHoles.contains c then
   184	        match env.find? c with
   185	        | some (.defnInfo v) => pure (some (definitionHoleMetadata v))
   186	        | _ => throwError "registered definition changed kind during extraction: {c}"
   187	      else pure none
   188	    match ← Lean.findDeclarationRanges? c with
   189	    | some r =>
   190	      let row := s!"{c}\t{path}\t{r.range.pos.line}\t{r.range.endPos.line}"
   191	      IO.println <| metadata.map (row ++ "\t" ++ ·) |>.getD row
   192	    | none =>
   193	      let row := s!"{c}\t{path}\tNORANGE\tNORANGE"
   194	      IO.println <| metadata.map (row ++ "\t" ++ ·) |>.getD row
   195	
   196	#eval runExtract

# Challenge: compact quantum Pauli basis test

This standalone Mathlib-only module states the compact forms of Pauli-basis
completeness, low-degree soundness, Pauli soundness, and binary-coordinate
Pauli soundness.  It preserves the complete question and answer carriers, all
verifier branches, bounded polynomial representatives, the fixed field and
basis contract, the unsquared state error, and the separate unaveraged squared
operator-error sums.

The four theorem values and the value of `MIPStarRE.QPBT.fixedFieldModel` are
the only intended holes.  The comparator checks the registered definition's
full type and checks its library value transitively for permitted axioms.
-/

/-- A finite two-player one-round game with a Mathlib probability mass function. -/
structure Game (X Y A B : Type) [Fintype X] [Fintype Y] [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
    [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y] [DecidableEq A] [DecidableEq B] where
  μ : PMF (X × Y)
  decide : X → Y → A → B → Bool
/-- A finite POVM, represented by positive semidefinite effects summing to the identity. -/
structure POVM (A I : Type*) [Fintype A] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] where
  effect : A → Matrix I I ℂ
  pos : ∀ a, (effect a).PosSemidef
  sum_eq_one : ∑ a, effect a = 1
/-- A finite-dimensional pure unit-state tensor-product strategy. -/
structure Strategy (X Y A B : Type) [Fintype X] [Fintype Y] [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
    where
  ιA : Type
  ιB : Type
  [ιAFintype : Fintype ιA]
  [ιBFintype : Fintype ιB]
  [ιADecidableEq : DecidableEq ιA]
  [ιBDecidableEq : DecidableEq ιB]
  ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)
  ψ_norm : ‖ψ‖ = 1
  alice : X → POVM A ιA
  bob : Y → POVM B ιB

-- source: compact Palomar definitions (attribute command)
attribute [instance] Strategy.ιAFintype Strategy.ιBFintype
  Strategy.ιADecidableEq Strategy.ιBDecidableEq
/-- Reindex a finite Euclidean state along an equivalence of coordinates. -/
noncomputable def reindexState {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J] (e : I ≃ J)
    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ I) : EuclideanSpace ℂ J :=
  (EuclideanSpace.equiv J ℂ).symm (fun j => (EuclideanSpace.equiv I ℂ ψ) (e.symm j))
/-- A swap-invariant strategy using one local space and one measurement family. -/
structure SymmetricStrategy (X A : Type) [Fintype X] [Fintype A] where
  ι : Type
  [ιFintype : Fintype ι]
  [ιDecidableEq : DecidableEq ι]
  ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ι × ι)
  ψ_norm : ‖ψ‖ = 1
  ψ_swap : reindexState (Equiv.prodComm ι ι) ψ = ψ
  meas : X → POVM A ι

-- source: compact Palomar definitions (attribute command)
attribute [instance] SymmetricStrategy.ιFintype SymmetricStrategy.ιDecidableEq
/-- Regard a symmetric strategy as a general tensor-product strategy. -/
def SymmetricStrategy.toStrategy {X A : Type} [Fintype X] [Fintype A]
    (S : SymmetricStrategy X A) : Strategy X X A A where
  ιA := S.ι
  ιB := S.ι
  ψ := S.ψ
  ψ_norm := S.ψ_norm
  alice := S.meas
  bob := S.meas
/-- The Born weight of a fixed question and answer tuple. -/
noncomputable def Strategy.outcomeWeight {X Y A B : Type}
    [Fintype X] [Fintype Y] [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
  (S : Strategy X Y A B) (x : X) (y : Y) (a : A) (b : B) : ℝ :=
  (inner ℂ S.ψ (Matrix.toEuclideanLin
    (Matrix.kronecker ((S.alice x).effect a) ((S.bob y).effect b)) S.ψ)).re
/-- The tensor-product Born value of a strategy in a finite game. -/
noncomputable def Strategy.value {X Y A B : Type} [Fintype X] [Fintype Y]
    [Fintype A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y]
    [DecidableEq A] [DecidableEq B] (S : Strategy X Y A B) (G : Game X Y A B) : ℝ :=
  ∑ xy, (G.μ xy).toReal * ∑ a, ∑ b,
    if G.decide xy.1 xy.2 a b then S.outcomeWeight xy.1 xy.2 a b else 0
/-- Every effect of a projective POVM is a self-adjoint idempotent. -/

     1	import MIPStarRE.LDT.Basic.ParametersBase
     2	
     3	/-!
     4	# Finite-field bases and the fixed binary representation
     5	
     6	The Pauli basis test uses fields of size `2^k` for odd `k`, together with a
     7	chosen self-dual normal basis over `ZMod 2`.  This file constructs such bases
     8	and records the resulting fixed field model for later proofs.
     9	
    10	## References
    11	
    12	The declarations correspond to blueprint `def:admissible-size`,
    13	`def:dual-self-dual-normal-basis`, `def:subfields-kappa`, `def:subfield-trace`,
    14	and `def:binary-representation`.
    15	Their paper origin is `references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex:433-502,653-728`.
    16	-/
    17	
    18	open scoped BigOperators
    19	
    20	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    21	
    22	/-- `IsAdmissibleSize q` is the predicate `q = 2^k` for an odd exponent.
    23	This is blueprint `def:admissible-size`, with paper origin
    24	`references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex:662-667`.
    25	-/
    26	def IsAdmissibleSize (q : ℕ) : Prop := ∃ k : ℕ, Odd k ∧ q = 2 ^ k
    27	
    28	/-- An admissible field size is at least two, its binary exponent being odd
    29	and therefore positive.  This is a property of blueprint
    30	`def:admissible-size`, paper origin
    31	`references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex:662-667`.
    32	-/
    33	theorem IsAdmissibleSize.two_le {q : ℕ} (hq : IsAdmissibleSize q) : 2 ≤ q := by
    34	  obtain ⟨k, hk, hqk⟩ := hq
    35	  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hk
    36	  rw [hqk, hj]
    37	  calc 2 = 2 ^ 1 := by norm_num
    38	    _ ≤ 2 ^ (2 * j + 1) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (by omega)
    39	
    40	/-- An admissible field size is either two or a multiple of eight: its binary
    41	exponent is odd, hence either one or at least three.  This is a property of
    42	blueprint
    43	`def:admissible-size`, paper origin
    44	`references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex:662-667`.
    45	-/
    46	theorem IsAdmissibleSize.eq_two_or_eight_dvd {q : ℕ} (hq : IsAdmissibleSize q) :
    47	    q = 2 ∨ 8 ∣ q := by
    48	  obtain ⟨k, hk, hqk⟩ := hq
    49	  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hk
    50	  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos j with hj0 | hj0
    51	  · left
    52	    rw [hqk, hj, hj0]
    53	    norm_num
    54	  · right
    55	    refine ⟨2 ^ (2 * j + 1 - 3), ?_⟩
    56	    rw [hqk, hj, show (8 : ℕ) = 2 ^ 3 by norm_num, ← pow_add]
    57	    congr 1
    58	    omega
    59	
    60	/-- A dual pair of bases for blueprint
    61	`def:dual-self-dual-normal-basis`, paper `04_preliminaries.tex:494-496`. -/
    62	def IsDualBasisPair {F K ι : Type*} [CommRing F] [CommRing K] [DecidableEq ι]
    63	    [Algebra F K] (b b' : Module.Basis ι F K) : Prop :=
    64	  ∀ i j, Algebra.trace F K (b i * b' j) = if i = j then 1 else 0
    65	
    66	namespace Basis
    67	
    68	/-- Self-duality in blueprint
    69	`def:dual-self-dual-normal-basis`, paper `04_preliminaries.tex:494-497`. -/
    70	def IsSelfDual {F K ι : Type*} [CommRing F] [CommRing K] [DecidableEq ι]
    71	    [Algebra F K] (b : Module.Basis ι F K) : Prop :=
    72	  IsDualBasisPair b b
    73	
    74	/-- Normality in blueprint
    75	`def:dual-self-dual-normal-basis`, paper `04_preliminaries.tex:498-502`. The
    76	Frobenius exponent uses the cardinality of the base field. -/
    77	def IsNormal {F K : Type*} [CommSemiring F] [Fintype F] [Field K] [Algebra F K]
    78	    {k : ℕ} (b : Module.Basis (Fin k) F K) : Prop :=
    79	  ∃ α : K, ∀ j, b j = α ^ (Fintype.card F ^ j.1)

    83	/- The characteristic-two self-dual normal-basis construction is carried out

    95	
    96	theorem monoid_algebra_sq_eq_dom_congr (hodd : Odd (Nat.card G))

 # Axiom audits for the quantum Pauli basis test
 
 Reviewer-facing, machine-checked evidence that the QPBT headline results rest on
 nothing beyond Lean's three standard axioms.  Before this module the claim was
 reproducible only by running a throwaway metaprogram outside the repository; a
 reader of the artifact could not re-derive it.
 
-Each audit below both **prints** the axiom set of a headline declaration and
-**fails elaboration** unless that set is exactly

 `{Classical.choice, Quot.sound, propext}`.
 
 So the module is a compile-time regression test, not a report: if a `sorry`
 (`sorryAx`), a new `axiom` declaration, or any other unexpected dependency ever
 reaches one of these theorems, `lake build MIPStarRE.QPBT.Test.AxiomAudit`
 fails and CI goes red.  The printed lines remain in the build log as the
 positive record.
 
 This mirrors `MIPStarRE/LDT/Test/AxiomAudit.lean`, which uses the same
 `Lean.collectAxioms` mechanism for the classical low-individual-degree track.
 Like that module, this one is built explicitly as a CI target rather than
 imported from the `MIPStarRE.QPBT` umbrella, so the audits stay out of normal
 downstream imports while still acting as regression tests.
 
 ## What is audited
 
 The declarations are the QPBT headline results, in dependency order from the
 soundness statement down to the combining and extraction layers:
 
 * `pauli_soundness` — the main theorem (blueprint `thm:pauli`).
 * `pauli_soundness_qubit` — its qubit form (`cor:pauli-binary`).
 * `pauli_soundness_explicit_baseline` and
   `pauli_soundness_qubit_explicit_baseline` — the Lean-only issue #729
   quantitative specializations with fixed current-proof constants.
 * `pauli_soundness_quantitative` and
   `pauli_soundness_qubit_quantitative` — the structured degree-four issue #729
   bounds, with internally constructed global and extraction witnesses.
 * `pauli_soundness_quantitative_mixed_components` and its exact qubit form —
   the capped squared-state and separate raw-operator component bounds.
 * `pauli_soundness_quantitative_fractional` and its exact qubit form — the
   terminal fractional-dimensional common bound from the native estimates.
 * `pauli_soundness_quantitative_degree_two` and its exact qubit form — the
   sharper degree-two issue #729 bounds, reconstructed on their nonsaturated
   branch.
 * `pauli_soundness_quantitative_canonical` and
   `pauli_soundness_qubit_quantitative_canonical` — the corresponding canonical
   `deltaQld 100` bounds at exponent `1 / 67108864`.
 * `exists_ld_soundness` — quantum low-degree soundness (`lem:ld-soundness`).
 * `exists_spcc_value_one` and `honestStrategy_isSPCC` — completeness, which is
   what keeps the soundness hypothesis non-vacuous.
 * `exists_combinedLinesWitness`, `exists_extendedLinesWitness_established`,
   `exists_globalPairWitness`, `exists_actual_rounded_global_pair_error_bound`,
   and the native quantitative global-pair constructor, fractional comparison,
   and legacy comparison — the combining layer.
 * `exists_projective_setting_isometry_bounds`,
   `exists_arbitrary_strategy_isometry_bounds`,
   `pauli_soundness_deltaQld_ofExtractionWitness` — the extraction layer.
 * `exists_symmetric_projective_strategy_approx` — the symmetrization interface.

 `exists_extendedLinesWitness_established` and

A configuration names the Lean modules the extractor imports, the target
theorems whose statement closure it takes, the header and footer files wrapped
around the assembled body, the checked-in expected copy, and the per-challenge
elaboration-context tables (`extras`, `module_preludes`).  The schema, with the
meaning of every key, is documented at the top of `challenge_config.py`; unknown
keys are rejected, so a typo fails loudly rather than silently dropping context.

### Registered definition frontiers

The optional `definition_names` list implements the official comparator's
named-definition frontier.  Each registered name must resolve to a
repository-local definition.  Its full type and every dependency of that type
remain in the extracted closure, but its value is not traversed.  Every
unregistered definition value and theorem proof reached by the ordinary closure
is still traversed.

The assembler copies the registered declaration's source header, preserving its
name, universe parameters, binders, return type, and safety modifier, and
replaces only its generated Challenge value with `by sorry`.  Missing names and
names that are not definitions fail extraction.  The fifth closure-TSV column
records the definition safety checked from Lean metadata.

This Challenge hole is not a permission for an unchecked Solution axiom.  The
official comparator compares the registered definition's name, universes, type,
and safety while deliberately ignoring its Challenge value.  It separately
traverses the actual Solution definition value during the Solution axiom audit.
Thus the generated Challenge may contain `sorryAx` at the registered value, but
the checked Solution must still supply an implementation using only the
permitted axioms.  Registering one definition does not erase unrelated helper
proofs or values.  `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Test/AxiomAudit.lean` checks the actual
`fixedFieldModel` value transitively and currently requires exactly the same
three standard Lean axioms as the four theorem aliases.

The historical LDT and QPBT challenges do not set `definition_names`; omitting
it or setting it to `[]` preserves their extraction and golden fixtures
byte-for-byte.  The compact Palomar challenge registers only
`MIPStarRE.QPBT.fixedFieldModel`.

   386	/-- The compact question PMF is exactly the registered question distribution. -/
   387	theorem pauliQuestionPMF_map (P : MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) :
   388	    (pauliQuestionPMF (PauliParams.ofAdmissibleParams P)
   389	        (MIPStarRE.QPBT.binaryRepresentation P.model)).map (pauliQuestionPairEquiv P) =
   390	      (MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliBasisTest P).μ.toPMF
   391	        (MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliBasisTest P).μ_prob := by
   392	  classical
   393	  letI : Nonempty MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliEdge := MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliEdge_nonempty
   394	  let compactMap := fun s : PauliEdge ×
   395	      PauliSpace (PauliParams.ofAdmissibleParams P) (MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) =>
   396	    ((s.1.1.1, pauliMap (PauliParams.ofAdmissibleParams P)
   397	        (MIPStarRE.QPBT.binaryRepresentation P.model) s.1.1.1 s.2),
   398	      (s.1.1.2, pauliMap (PauliParams.ofAdmissibleParams P)
   399	        (MIPStarRE.QPBT.binaryRepresentation P.model) s.1.1.2 s.2))
   400	  let originalMap := fun s :
   401	      MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliEdge × MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliSpace P =>
   402	    ((s.1.1.1, MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliCL P s.1.1.1 s.2),
   403	      (s.1.1.2, MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliCL P s.1.1.2 s.2))
   404	  have hcomm : pauliQuestionPairEquiv P ∘ compactMap =
   405	      originalMap ∘ pauliSourceEquiv P := by
   406	    funext s
   407	    apply Prod.ext
   408	    · apply Prod.ext
   409	      · rfl
   410	      · exact pauliMap_equiv P s.1.1.1 s.2
   411	    · apply Prod.ext
   412	      · rfl
   413	      · exact pauliMap_equiv P s.1.1.2 s.2
   414	  rw [show pauliQuestionPMF (PauliParams.ofAdmissibleParams P)
   415	      (MIPStarRE.QPBT.binaryRepresentation P.model) =
   416	        (PMF.uniformOfFintype _).map compactMap by rfl]
   417	  rw [PMF.map_comp, hcomm, ← PMF.map_comp]
   418	  rw [PMF.uniformOfFintype_map_equiv (pauliSourceEquiv P)]
   419	  have hmap :=
   420	    (MIPStarRE.LDT.Distribution.toPMF_map
   421	      (MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution
   422	        (MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliEdge × MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliSpace P))
   423	      (MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution_isProbability
   424	        (MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliEdge × MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliSpace P)) originalMap).symm
   425	  rw [MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution_toPMF] at hmap
   426	  simpa only [MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliBasisTest,
   427	    MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliQuestionDistribution] using hmap

   522	/-- The compact Boolean verifier is exactly the registered verifier after relabeling. -/
   523	theorem pauliWin_equiv (P : MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams)
   524	    (x y : PauliQuestion (PauliParams.ofAdmissibleParams P)
   525	      (MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P))
   526	    (a b : PauliAnswer (PauliParams.ofAdmissibleParams P)
   527	      (MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P)) :
   528	    pauliWin (PauliParams.ofAdmissibleParams P)
   529	        (MIPStarRE.QPBT.binaryRepresentation P.model)
   530	        (MIPStarRE.QPBT.fixedBinTrace P.model) x y a b =
   531	      MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliWinPredicate P (pauliQuestionEquiv P x)
   532	        (pauliQuestionEquiv P y) (pauliAnswerEquivCompact P a)
   533	        (pauliAnswerEquivCompact P b) := by
   534	  rcases x with ⟨tA, xA⟩
   535	  rcases y with ⟨tB, xB⟩
   536	  unfold pauliWin MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliWinPredicate
   537	  simp only [pauliQuestionEquiv, Equiv.prodCongr_apply, Prod.map_fst, Prod.map_snd]
   538	  rw [← validPauliAnswer_equiv P tA a, ← validPauliAnswer_equiv P tB b]
   539	  by_cases hv : (validPauliAnswer tA a && validPauliAnswer tB b) = true
   540	  · rw [if_pos hv, if_pos hv]
   541	    by_cases ht : tA = tB
   542	    · have ht' : pauliTypeEquiv tA = pauliTypeEquiv tB := congrArg pauliTypeEquiv ht
   543	      rw [if_pos ht, if_pos ht']
   544	      apply decide_eq_decide.mpr
   545	      constructor
   546	      · exact fun h => congrArg (pauliAnswerEquivCompact P) h
   547	      · exact fun h => (pauliAnswerEquivCompact P).injective h
   548	    · have ht' : pauliTypeEquiv tA ≠ pauliTypeEquiv tB :=
   549	        fun h => ht (pauliTypeEquiv.injective h)
   550	      rw [if_neg ht, if_neg ht']
   551	      obtain ⟨hvA, hvB⟩ := Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp hv
   552	      rcases tA with (_ | _) | (_ | _) | (_ | _) | (_ | _) | (_ | _) | _ | i | j <;>
   553	        rcases a with uA | fA | gA | bitsA | bitA | tripleA | outcomeA <;>
   554	        (try exact Bool.noConfusion hvA) <;>
   555	        rcases tB with (_ | _) | (_ | _) | (_ | _) | (_ | _) | (_ | _) | _ | i' | j' <;>
   556	        rcases b with uB | fB | gB | bitsB | bitB | tripleB | outcomeB <;>
   557	        (try exact Bool.noConfusion hvB) <;>
   558	        simp [pauliTypeEquiv, pauliKindEquiv, pauliAnswerEquivCompact,

   566	          lowDegreeEval_eq_evalCoefficient, magicVariable_eq_msConstraintVars,

     8	This module identifies the compact product-space game with the existing
     9	low-degree game.  The bridge is by explicit equivalences of question

    11	of the Boolean verifier, and the value of every compact strategy exactly.

    98	/-- The compact least nonzero coordinate is the one used by the published formula. -/
    99	theorem lowDegreePivot_eq_linePivotIndex {K : Type} [Field K] [DecidableEq K]
   100	    {m : ℕ} (v : Fin m → K) (hv : v ≠ 0) :
   101	    lowDegreePivot v hv = MIPStarRE.QPBT.linePivotIndex v hv := by
   102	  have hpivot_ne : v (lowDegreePivot v hv) ≠ 0 := by
   103	    unfold lowDegreePivot
   104	    change v ((Finset.univ.filter fun j : Fin m => v j ≠ 0).min' _) ≠ 0
   105	    exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.min'_mem
   106	      (Finset.univ.filter fun j : Fin m => v j ≠ 0) _)).2
   107	  have hpivot_le (i : Fin m) (hi : v i ≠ 0) : lowDegreePivot v hv ≤ i := by
   108	    unfold lowDegreePivot
   109	    change (Finset.univ.filter fun j : Fin m => v j ≠ 0).min' _ ≤ i
   110	    exact Finset.min'_le _ i (by simp [hi])
   111	  apply le_antisymm
   112	  · exact hpivot_le _ (MIPStarRE.QPBT.linePivotIndex_ne_zero v hv)
   113	  · apply le_of_not_gt
   114	    intro hlt
   115	    exact hpivot_ne (MIPStarRE.QPBT.linePivotIndex_zero_before v hv _ hlt)

   122	  simp only [lowDegreeLineRep, MIPStarRE.QPBT.explicitLineRep]
   123	  split_ifs with hv

   128	theorem lowDegreeMap_point_equiv (P : MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams)
   129	    (z : LowDegreeSpace (LowDegreeParams.ofLdParams P) (MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ P)) :
   130	    lowDegreeSpaceEquiv P
   131	        (lowDegreeMap (LowDegreeParams.ofLdParams P)
   132	          (MIPStarRE.QPBT.binaryRepresentation P.model)
   133	          .point z) =
   134	      MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldPointCL P (lowDegreeSpaceEquiv P z) := by

   137	/-- The compact axis-line map agrees with the original axis-line map. -/
   138	theorem lowDegreeMap_aline_equiv (P : MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams)
   139	    (z : LowDegreeSpace (LowDegreeParams.ofLdParams P) (MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ P)) :
   140	    lowDegreeSpaceEquiv P
   141	        (lowDegreeMap (LowDegreeParams.ofLdParams P)
   142	          (MIPStarRE.QPBT.binaryRepresentation P.model)
   143	          .aline z) =
   144	      MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldALineCL P (lowDegreeSpaceEquiv P z) := by
   145	  funext i
   146	  rcases i with (j | u) | j

   192	/-- The compact question PMF is exactly the original question distribution. -/
   193	theorem lowDegreeQuestionPMF_map (P : MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams) :
   194	    (lowDegreeQuestionPMF (LowDegreeParams.ofLdParams P)
   195	        (MIPStarRE.QPBT.binaryRepresentation P.model)).map
   196	        (lowDegreeQuestionPairEquiv P) =
   197	      (MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldGame P).μ.toPMF (MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldGame P).μ_prob := by
   198	  let compactMap := fun z :
   199	      (LowDegreeType × LowDegreeType) ×
   200	        LowDegreeSpace (LowDegreeParams.ofLdParams P) (MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ P) =>
   201	    ((z.1.1, lowDegreeMap (LowDegreeParams.ofLdParams P)
   202	        (MIPStarRE.QPBT.binaryRepresentation P.model) z.1.1 z.2),
   203	      (z.1.2, lowDegreeMap (LowDegreeParams.ofLdParams P)
   204	        (MIPStarRE.QPBT.binaryRepresentation P.model) z.1.2 z.2))
   205	  let originalMap := fun z :
   206	      (MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdType × MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdType) ×
   207	        MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdSpace P =>
   208	    ((z.1.1, MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldCL P z.1.1 z.2),
   209	      (z.1.2, MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldCL P z.1.2 z.2))
   210	  have hcomm : lowDegreeQuestionPairEquiv P ∘ compactMap =
   211	      originalMap ∘ lowDegreeSourceEquiv P := by
   212	    funext z
   213	    apply Prod.ext
   214	    · apply Prod.ext
   215	      · rfl
   216	      · exact lowDegreeMap_equiv P z.1.1 z.2
   217	    · apply Prod.ext
   218	      · rfl
   219	      · exact lowDegreeMap_equiv P z.1.2 z.2
   220	  rw [show lowDegreeQuestionPMF (LowDegreeParams.ofLdParams P)
   221	      (MIPStarRE.QPBT.binaryRepresentation P.model) =
   222	        (PMF.uniformOfFintype _).map compactMap by rfl]
   223	  rw [PMF.map_comp, hcomm, ← PMF.map_comp]
   224	  rw [PMF.uniformOfFintype_map_equiv (lowDegreeSourceEquiv P)]
   225	  have hmap :=
   226	    (MIPStarRE.LDT.Distribution.toPMF_map
   227	      (MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution
   228	        ((MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdType × MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdType) ×
   229	          MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdSpace P))
   230	      (MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution_isProbability
   231	        ((MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdType × MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdType) ×
   232	          MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdSpace P)) originalMap).symm
   233	  rw [MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution_toPMF] at hmap
   234	  simpa only [MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldGame, MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldQuestionDistribution] using hmap

     4	# Strategy bridge for the compact low individual degree game
     5	
     6	This module transports compact strategies across the exact question and answer
     7	equivalences of `LowDegreeGameBridge`.  The transported game is the existing
     8	low-degree game, and every compact strategy has exactly the same Born value
     9	after conversion through the Palomar foundation bridge.

    11	## References
    12	
    13	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-440`.

    24	/-- Relabel the outcomes of a compact POVM along an equivalence. -/
    25	def relabel {A B I : Type*} [Fintype A] [Fintype B] [Fintype I]
    26	    [DecidableEq I] (e : A ≃ B) (M : POVM A I) : POVM B I where
    27	  effect := fun b => M.effect (e.symm b)
    28	  pos := fun b => M.pos (e.symm b)
    29	  sum_eq_one := by
    30	    calc
    31	      ∑ b : B, M.effect (e.symm b) = ∑ a : A, M.effect a :=
    32	        Equiv.sum_comp e.symm M.effect
    33	      _ = 1 := M.sum_eq_one
    34	
    35	/-- Outcome relabeling preserves every POVM effect. -/
    36	@[simp] theorem relabel_effect {A B I : Type*} [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
    37	    [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] (e : A ≃ B) (M : POVM A I) (b : B) :
    38	    (relabel e M).effect b = M.effect (e.symm b) :=
    39	  rfl

    41	/-- Outcome relabeling preserves projectivity exactly. -/
    42	theorem relabel_isProjective_iff {A B I : Type*} [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
    43	    [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] (e : A ≃ B) (M : POVM A I) :
    44	    (relabel e M).IsProjective ↔ M.IsProjective := by
    45	  constructor
    46	  · intro h a
    47	    simpa using h (e a)
    48	  · intro h b
    49	    exact h (e.symm b)
    50

    55	/-- Two compact games on fixed carriers are equal when their data fields agree. -/
    56	theorem ext {X Y A B : Type}
    57	    [Fintype X] [Fintype Y] [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
    58	    [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y] [DecidableEq A] [DecidableEq B]
    59	    {G H : Game X Y A B} (hμ : G.μ = H.μ) (hdecide : G.decide = H.decide) :
    60	    G = H := by
    61	  cases G
    62	  cases H
    63	  simp_all

    65	/-- Relabel all question and answer carriers of a compact game. -/
    66	def relabel {X Y A B X' Y' A' B' : Type}
    67	    [Fintype X] [Fintype Y] [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
    68	    [Fintype X'] [Fintype Y'] [Fintype A'] [Fintype B']
    69	    [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y] [DecidableEq A] [DecidableEq B]
    70	    [DecidableEq X'] [DecidableEq Y'] [DecidableEq A'] [DecidableEq B']
    71	    (G : Game X Y A B) (eX : X ≃ X') (eY : Y ≃ Y')
    72	    (eA : A ≃ A') (eB : B ≃ B') : Game X' Y' A' B' where
    73	  μ := G.μ.map (Equiv.prodCongr eX eY)
    74	  decide := fun x y a b =>
    75	    G.decide (eX.symm x) (eY.symm y) (eA.symm a) (eB.symm b)
    76	
    77	end Game

    81	/-- Relabel the questions and outcomes of a compact strategy. -/
    82	def relabel {X Y A B X' Y' A' B' : Type}
    83	    [Fintype X] [Fintype Y] [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
    84	    [Fintype X'] [Fintype Y'] [Fintype A'] [Fintype B']
    85	    (S : Strategy X Y A B) (eX : X ≃ X') (eY : Y ≃ Y')
    86	    (eA : A ≃ A') (eB : B ≃ B') : Strategy X' Y' A' B' where
    87	  ιA := S.ιA
    88	  ιB := S.ιB
    89	  ψ := S.ψ
    90	  ψ_norm := S.ψ_norm
    91	  alice := fun x => POVM.relabel eA (S.alice (eX.symm x))
    92	  bob := fun y => POVM.relabel eB (S.bob (eY.symm y))

    94	/-- Relabeling preserves each Born weight after pulling back all four labels. -/
    95	@[simp] theorem outcomeWeight_relabel {X Y A B X' Y' A' B' : Type}
    96	    [Fintype X] [Fintype Y] [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
    97	    [Fintype X'] [Fintype Y'] [Fintype A'] [Fintype B']
    98	    (S : Strategy X Y A B) (eX : X ≃ X') (eY : Y ≃ Y')
    99	    (eA : A ≃ A') (eB : B ≃ B') (x : X') (y : Y') (a : A') (b : B') :
   100	    (relabel S eX eY eA eB).outcomeWeight x y a b =
   101	      S.outcomeWeight (eX.symm x) (eY.symm y) (eA.symm a) (eB.symm b) :=
   102	  rfl

   104	/-- Relabeling preserves projectivity exactly. -/
   105	theorem relabel_isProjective_iff {X Y A B X' Y' A' B' : Type}
   106	    [Fintype X] [Fintype Y] [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
   107	    [Fintype X'] [Fintype Y'] [Fintype A'] [Fintype B']
   108	    (S : Strategy X Y A B) (eX : X ≃ X') (eY : Y ≃ Y')
   109	    (eA : A ≃ A') (eB : B ≃ B') :
   110	    (relabel S eX eY eA eB).IsProjective ↔ S.IsProjective := by
   111	  constructor
   112	  · rintro ⟨hA, hB⟩
   113	    constructor
   114	    · intro x
   115	      have hx := hA (eX x)
   116	      change (POVM.relabel eA (S.alice (eX.symm (eX x)))).IsProjective at hx
   117	      rw [eX.symm_apply_apply] at hx
   118	      exact (POVM.relabel_isProjective_iff eA (S.alice x)).mp hx
   119	    · intro y
   120	      have hy := hB (eY y)
   121	      change (POVM.relabel eB (S.bob (eY.symm (eY y)))).IsProjective at hy
   122	      rw [eY.symm_apply_apply] at hy
   123	      exact (POVM.relabel_isProjective_iff eB (S.bob y)).mp hy
   124	  · rintro ⟨hA, hB⟩
   125	    constructor
   126	    · intro x
   127	      exact (POVM.relabel_isProjective_iff eA (S.alice (eX.symm x))).mpr
   128	        (hA (eX.symm x))
   129	    · intro y
   130	      exact (POVM.relabel_isProjective_iff eB (S.bob (eY.symm y))).mpr
   131	        (hB (eY.symm y))

   133	/-- A double finite sum is invariant under equivalences of both indices. -/
   134	private theorem sum_equiv₂ {A B A' B' : Type*} [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
   135	    [Fintype A'] [Fintype B'] (eA : A ≃ A') (eB : B ≃ B')
   136	    (f : A → B → ℝ) :
   137	    (∑ a : A', ∑ b : B', f (eA.symm a) (eB.symm b)) =
   138	      ∑ a : A, ∑ b : B, f a b := by
   139	  calc
   140	    (∑ a : A', ∑ b : B', f (eA.symm a) (eB.symm b)) =
   141	        ∑ a : A, ∑ b : B', f a (eB.symm b) :=
   142	      Equiv.sum_comp eA.symm (fun a => ∑ b : B', f a (eB.symm b))
   143	    _ = ∑ a : A, ∑ b : B, f a b := by
   144	      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   145	      intro a _
   146	      exact Equiv.sum_comp eB.symm (f a)
   147	
   148	/-- Simultaneous relabeling of a compact game and strategy preserves value exactly. -/
   149	theorem value_relabel {X Y A B X' Y' A' B' : Type}
   150	    [Fintype X] [Fintype Y] [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
   151	    [Fintype X'] [Fintype Y'] [Fintype A'] [Fintype B']
   152	    [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y] [DecidableEq A] [DecidableEq B]
   153	    [DecidableEq X'] [DecidableEq Y'] [DecidableEq A'] [DecidableEq B']
   154	    (G : Game X Y A B) (S : Strategy X Y A B)
   155	    (eX : X ≃ X') (eY : Y ≃ Y') (eA : A ≃ A') (eB : B ≃ B') :
   156	    (relabel S eX eY eA eB).value (Game.relabel G eX eY eA eB) =
   157	      S.value G := by
   158	  unfold Strategy.value
   159	  change PMF.realWeightedSum (G.μ.map (Equiv.prodCongr eX eY)) _ =
   160	    PMF.realWeightedSum G.μ _
   161	  rw [PMF.realWeightedSum_map]
   162	  apply congrArg (PMF.realWeightedSum G.μ)
   163	  funext xy
   164	  simp only [Game.relabel, Equiv.prodCongr_apply, Prod.map_fst, Prod.map_snd,
   165	    outcomeWeight_relabel, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
   166	  exact sum_equiv₂ eA eB (fun a b =>
   167	    if G.decide xy.1 xy.2 a b then S.outcomeWeight xy.1 xy.2 a b else 0)
   168	
   169	end Strategy

   171	/-- Relabeling the concrete compact game gives the original registered game. -/
   172	theorem lowDegreeGame_relabel_eq (P : MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams) :
   173	    Game.relabel
   174	        (lowDegreeGame (LowDegreeParams.ofLdParams P)
   175	          (MIPStarRE.QPBT.binaryRepresentation P.model))
   176	        (lowDegreeQuestionEquiv P) (lowDegreeQuestionEquiv P)
   177	        (lowDegreeAnswerEquiv P) (lowDegreeAnswerEquiv P) =
   178	      Game.ofGame (MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldGame P) := by
   179	  apply Game.ext
   180	  · exact lowDegreeQuestionPMF_map P
   181	  · funext x y a b
   182	    change lowDegreeWin (LowDegreeParams.ofLdParams P)
   183	        (MIPStarRE.QPBT.binaryRepresentation P.model)
   184	        ((lowDegreeQuestionEquiv P).symm x) ((lowDegreeQuestionEquiv P).symm y)
   185	        ((lowDegreeAnswerEquiv P).symm a) ((lowDegreeAnswerEquiv P).symm b) =
   186	      MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldWinPredicate P x y a b
   187	    simpa using lowDegreeWin_equiv P
   188	      ((lowDegreeQuestionEquiv P).symm x) ((lowDegreeQuestionEquiv P).symm y)
   189	      ((lowDegreeAnswerEquiv P).symm a) ((lowDegreeAnswerEquiv P).symm b)

   191	/-- Convert a compact low-degree strategy into a strategy for the registered game. -/
   192	def lowDegreeStrategyToLibrary (P : MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams)

   198	    MIPStarRE.QPBT.Strategy (MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldGame P) :=
   199	  Strategy.toStrategy (G := MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldGame P)

   204	/-- Conversion to the registered low-degree game preserves the strategy value exactly. -/
   205	theorem lowDegreeStrategyToLibrary_value (P : MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams)
   206	    (S : Strategy
   207	      (LowDegreeQuestion (LowDegreeParams.ofLdParams P) (MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ P))
   208	      (LowDegreeQuestion (LowDegreeParams.ofLdParams P) (MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ P))
   209	      (LowDegreeAnswer (LowDegreeParams.ofLdParams P) (MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ P))
   210	      (LowDegreeAnswer (LowDegreeParams.ofLdParams P) (MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ P))) :
   211	    (lowDegreeStrategyToLibrary P S).value =
   212	      S.value (lowDegreeGame (LowDegreeParams.ofLdParams P)
   213	        (MIPStarRE.QPBT.binaryRepresentation P.model)) := by
   214	  let S' := Strategy.relabel S
   215	    (lowDegreeQuestionEquiv P) (lowDegreeQuestionEquiv P)
   216	    (lowDegreeAnswerEquiv P) (lowDegreeAnswerEquiv P)

    30	/-- Pushing a PMF through an equivalence preserves its mass at corresponding points. -/
    31	@[simp] theorem map_equiv_apply {X Y : Type*} (p : PMF X) (e : X ≃ Y) (x : X) :
    32	    (p.map e) (e x) = p x := by
    33	  classical
    34	  simp [PMF.map_apply, e.injective.eq_iff]
    35	
    36	/-- A PMF pushed through an equivalence is evaluated by pulling the point back. -/
    37	theorem map_equiv_apply' {X Y : Type*} (p : PMF X) (e : X ≃ Y) (y : Y) :
    38	    (p.map e) y = p (e.symm y) := by
    39	  simpa only [e.apply_symm_apply] using map_equiv_apply p e (e.symm y)
    40	
    41	end PMF

    45	/-- Outcome relabeling preserves state-dependent consistency exactly. -/
    46	theorem relabel_isConsistentOn_iff {A B I : Type*} [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
    47	    [Fintype I] [DecidableEq A] [DecidableEq B] [DecidableEq I]
    48	    (e : A ≃ B) (M : POVM A I) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (I × I)) :
    49	    (relabel e M).IsConsistentOn ψ ↔ M.IsConsistentOn ψ := by
    50	  constructor
    51	  · intro h a
    52	    simpa using h (e a)
    53	  · intro h b
    54	    exact h (e.symm b)
    55	
    56	end POVM

    58	/-- Positive-support commutation is invariant under exact question and outcome relabeling. -/
    59	theorem isCommutingOn_relabel_iff
    60	    {X Y A B X' Y' A' B' I : Type*}
    61	    [Fintype X] [Fintype Y] [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
    62	    [Fintype X'] [Fintype Y'] [Fintype A'] [Fintype B']
    63	    [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    64	    (μ : PMF (X × Y)) (alice : X → POVM A I) (bob : Y → POVM B I)
    65	    (eX : X ≃ X') (eY : Y ≃ Y') (eA : A ≃ A') (eB : B ≃ B') :
    66	    IsCommutingOn (μ.map (Equiv.prodCongr eX eY))
    67	        (fun x => POVM.relabel eA (alice (eX.symm x)))
    68	        (fun y => POVM.relabel eB (bob (eY.symm y))) ↔
    69	      IsCommutingOn μ alice bob := by
    70	  constructor
    71	  · intro h x y hxy a b
    72	    have hxy' : 0 < (μ.map (Equiv.prodCongr eX eY)) (eX x, eY y) := by
    73	      rw [show (eX x, eY y) = (Equiv.prodCongr eX eY) (x, y) by rfl]
    74	      simpa only [PMF.map_equiv_apply] using hxy
    75	    simpa using h (eX x) (eY y) hxy' (eA a) (eB b)
    76	  · intro h x y hxy a b
    77	    have hxy' : 0 < μ (eX.symm x, eY.symm y) := by
    78	      rw [PMF.map_equiv_apply'] at hxy
    79	      simpa using hxy
    80	    simpa using h (eX.symm x) (eY.symm y) hxy' (eA.symm a) (eB.symm b)
    81

    84	/-- Relabeling a compact game and then relabeling by the inverse equivalences is exact. -/
    85	theorem relabel_symm_relabel {X Y A B X' Y' A' B' : Type}
    86	    [Fintype X] [Fintype Y] [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
    87	    [Fintype X'] [Fintype Y'] [Fintype A'] [Fintype B']
    88	    [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y] [DecidableEq A] [DecidableEq B]
    89	    [DecidableEq X'] [DecidableEq Y'] [DecidableEq A'] [DecidableEq B']
    90	    (G : Game X Y A B) (eX : X ≃ X') (eY : Y ≃ Y')
    91	    (eA : A ≃ A') (eB : B ≃ B') :
    92	    Game.relabel (Game.relabel G eX eY eA eB)
    93	        eX.symm eY.symm eA.symm eB.symm = G := by
    94	  apply Game.ext
    95	  · ext xy
    96	    change ((G.μ.map (Equiv.prodCongr eX eY)).map
    97	      (Equiv.prodCongr eX.symm eY.symm)) xy = G.μ xy
    98	    rw [PMF.map_equiv_apply']
    99	    change (G.μ.map (Equiv.prodCongr eX eY))
   100	      ((Equiv.prodCongr eX eY) xy) = G.μ xy
   101	    exact PMF.map_equiv_apply G.μ (Equiv.prodCongr eX eY) xy
   102	  · funext x y a b
   103	    simp [Game.relabel]
   104	
   105	end Game

   109	/-- Relabel the questions and answers of a compact symmetric game. -/
   110	def relabel {X A X' A' : Type}
   111	    [Fintype X] [Fintype A] [Fintype X'] [Fintype A']
   112	    [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq A] [DecidableEq X'] [DecidableEq A']
   113	    (G : SymmetricGame X A) (eX : X ≃ X') (eA : A ≃ A') :
   114	    SymmetricGame X' A' where
   115	  toGame := Game.relabel G.toGame eX eX eA eA
   116	  μ_symm := by
   117	    intro x y
   118	    change (G.μ.map (Equiv.prodCongr eX eX)) (x, y) =
   119	      (G.μ.map (Equiv.prodCongr eX eX)) (y, x)
   120	    rw [PMF.map_equiv_apply', PMF.map_equiv_apply']
   121	    exact G.μ_symm (eX.symm x) (eX.symm y)
   122	  decide_symm := by
   123	    intro x y a b
   124	    exact G.decide_symm (eX.symm x) (eX.symm y) (eA.symm a) (eA.symm b)
   125	
   126	end SymmetricGame

   130	/-- Relabel the questions and outcomes of a compact symmetric strategy. -/
   131	def relabel {X A X' A' : Type}
   132	    [Fintype X] [Fintype A] [Fintype X'] [Fintype A']
   133	    (S : SymmetricStrategy X A) (eX : X ≃ X') (eA : A ≃ A') :
   134	    SymmetricStrategy X' A' where
   135	  ι := S.ι
   136	  ψ := S.ψ
   137	  ψ_norm := S.ψ_norm
   138	  ψ_swap := S.ψ_swap
   139	  meas := fun x => POVM.relabel eA (S.meas (eX.symm x))

   141	/-- Symmetric relabeling agrees with relabeling the underlying general strategy. -/
   142	@[simp] theorem relabel_toStrategy {X A X' A' : Type}
   143	    [Fintype X] [Fintype A] [Fintype X'] [Fintype A']
   144	    (S : SymmetricStrategy X A) (eX : X ≃ X') (eA : A ≃ A') :
   145	    (relabel S eX eA).toStrategy =
